desc.pack_dsl: A revolutionary one-person tent pitched with a trekking pole, with a roomy vestibule and a wide entrance. One of the lightest models on the outdoor market, made of extremely lightweight yet very durable materials. With all guy lines in use it is also very stable.
desc.fly_dsl: An ultralight all-season expedition tent with a modern construction and high-quality, durable materials and components. Two entrances and two spacious vestibules give the occupants plenty of comfort. Quick and easy pitching is another advantage.
desc.himlite_dsl: A very light two-person tent for all-season use. Extremely lightweight yet very durable materials. The tent stands out with its simple and sturdy duralumin pole structure, a roomy vestibule and a wide entrance.
desc.vector_dsl: An ultralight all-season expedition tent for 2 persons. A modern construction of three crossing duralumin poles with high-quality, durable materials and components. Two entrances, two spacious vestibules and perfect ventilation give the occupants plenty of comfort. Quick and easy pitching is another advantage.
desc.delta_d: A very light two-person tent for all-season use. Thanks to its weight and size it is ideal for cycle touring and paddling trips. The tent stands out with its simple and sturdy duralumin pole structure, a roomy vestibule and a wide entrance.
desc.spark_d: A comfortable trekking tunnel tent with a wide, roomy vestibule and ALU poles. The simple construction and quick pitching make this model suitable for a wide range of uses.
desc.apolos_d: A light all-season expedition tent for 2 persons. Excellent stability comes from the four-pole duralumin frame crossing at five points and from the high-quality, durable materials and components. Two symmetrical entrances, exceptionally spacious vestibules and perfect ventilation give the occupants plenty of comfort.
desc.bivak_d: A light and simple tent with two vestibules, made for users who value low weight and easy pitching. A big advantage is that the inner tent can be pitched on its own.
desc.alfa_d: A model for 2–3 persons with a duralumin frame and exceptional length for extra comfort. The generous vestibule provides room for luggage. Low weight and quick pitching are its main advantages. Duralumin poles.
desc.frontier_d: A tent for 2–3 persons. Two entrances with vestibules provide comfort for the occupants. The tent is also suitable for demanding conditions in high-mountain trekking; the three-pole frame withstands strong wind. The vestibules are roomy enough for luggage or cooking. Duralumin poles.
desc.apolom_d: A light all-season expedition tent for 3 persons. Excellent stability comes from the four-pole duralumin frame crossing at five points and from the high-quality, durable materials and components. Two symmetrical entrances, exceptionally spacious vestibules and perfect ventilation give the occupants plenty of comfort.
desc.thunder_d: A stable tent for 3 persons. The inner duralumin frame with an externally attached third pole provides excellent stability. Two symmetrical entrances that open to the left or right protect you when the weather changes. A well-designed ventilation system makes for comfortable camping.
desc.largo_d: A tent for 3–4 persons with a classic construction, a vestibule and one entrance. An ideal tent for standard use and demanding conditions alike. Easy pitching and low weight are its advantages. Duralumin poles.
desc.globe_d: A spacious tent for 3–4 persons. Two entrances and two roomy vestibules offer plenty of comfort, both for cooking and for storing luggage. This model impresses with a well-thought-out construction that provides ample stability and space.
desc.solo: A light trekking tunnel tent for one person with a unique top entrance as well as a front entrance. Quick and easy pitching is a big advantage. Perfect ventilation is provided by the roll-up flysheet; once rolled back it leaves a practical mosquito net that you will appreciate on warm summer nights.
desc.spark: A comfortable trekking tunnel tent with a wide, roomy vestibule. The simple construction and quick pitching make this model suitable for a wide range of uses.
desc.compact: A versatile tent for all outdoor activities. Ideal for daily moves by bike, on foot or on the water. The rigid free-standing frame makes this model suitable for more demanding conditions too. Low weight, easy pitching and a roomy vestibule provide plenty of comfort.
desc.alfa: A model for 2–3 persons with a Durawrap frame and exceptional length for extra comfort. The generous vestibule provides room for luggage. Low weight and quick pitching are its main advantages.
desc.largo: A tent for 3–4 persons with a classic construction, a vestibule and one entrance. An ideal tent for standard use and demanding conditions alike. Easy pitching and low weight are its advantages.
desc.magnum: A tent for 3–4 persons. Two entrances with vestibules provide comfort for the occupants. The tent is also suitable for demanding conditions in high-mountain trekking; the three-pole frame withstands strong wind. The vestibules are roomy enough for luggage or cooking.
desc.focus: A tent for 3–4 persons with a large, easily accessible vestibule that opens from two sides. The space can be used for emergency sleeping, storing bikes and so on. The tent is also suitable for family holidays. Its advantages are ample comfort and versatility.
desc.tornado: A spacious tent for 4 persons. The classic two-pole construction is reinforced by two more poles, giving enough stability for more demanding conditions. Two entrances and two roomy vestibules offer plenty of comfort, both for cooking and for storing luggage.
desc.enduro: A perfectly designed all-season tent. Its construction provides perfect comfort for four occupants. The ENDURO has 2 entrances and vestibules. The entrances are covered by the flysheet, giving perfect protection from insects and excellent ventilation at the same time. Two transparent windows bring in plenty of light and keep you in touch with the surroundings.
desc.duo: A simple tent with a vestibule and the smallest frame in the Trimm collection. It impresses with low weight and easy pitching.
desc.comet: A model for 2–3 persons with a traditional construction and exceptional length for extra comfort. The generous vestibule provides room for luggage. Low weight and quick pitching are its main advantages.
desc.hudson: A tent for 3–4 persons with a classic construction and a generous vestibule for comfortable camping. A reliable tent for family use. Its advantages are ample comfort at low weight and quick pitching.
desc.camp_ii: A spacious tent with highly variable entrances and a large vestibule that keeps the advantage of small tents – easy and quick pitching.
desc.arizona_ii: A tent for 4–5 persons. A comfortable family tent for camping or as a base for other sports activities. The spacious living vestibule is suitable for dining together, cooking or emergency sleeping for extra persons.
desc.comfort_ii: A large two-bedroom tent for the whole family. The four-pole frame crossing at five points resists wind and guarantees stability even in difficult conditions. The entrance panel can be propped up to form a canopy. Suitable for family trips into nature.
desc.macao: A spacious family tent for 5–6 persons. The shaped three-pole frame provides ample stability and interior space. A system of detachable panels allows perfect ventilation. This model can be joined with the popular shelter from our collection – the PARTY-S tent.
desc.macao_connector: A connector that joins the PARTY-S and MACAO tents.
desc.monzun: A spacious family tent with a sturdy six-pole frame that provides plenty of space and stability. The inner tent with an integrated floor and a well-designed ventilation system protects the occupants from insects, overheating and bad weather. The entrance and side panels can be propped up to form a canopy.
desc.galaxy_ii: A tent for 8–10 persons. A comfortable family tent for camping or as a base for other sports activities. The spacious living vestibule is suitable for dining together, cooking or emergency sleeping for extra persons.
desc.trace_one: A light single-skin shelter for undemanding hikers, anglers, trampers and cyclists. It does not promise the comfort of a classic tent, but its clear advantages are low weight and easy pitching with telescopic trekking poles.
desc.party: An elegant and simply designed picnic shelter, ideal for garden parties, that provides protection from harsh sun and rain. With the optional side walls you get perfect shade and shelter from the wind. One side wall is included in the basic package.
desc.party_bedroom: A practical bedroom that clips into the PARTY tent to create a versatile shelter you can sleep in. The bedroom covers half of the PARTY floor area.
desc.party_connector: A practical connector that joins two TRIMM PARTY tents, creating an exceptionally spacious shelter for your garden party or other events.
desc.party_floor: Floor for the Trimm PARTY tent.
desc.party_mosquito_net: A practical mosquito net for the PARTY tent. Clipped into the Trimm Party it creates a versatile shelter protected from annoying insects.
desc.party_wall: A side wall for the PARTY tent that easily closes the tent and provides protection from bad weather.
desc.party_s: An elegant and simply designed picnic shelter in a smaller version, ideal for garden parties, that provides protection from harsh sun and rain. With the optional side walls you get perfect shade and shelter from the wind. One side wall is included in the basic package.
desc.party_s_bedroom: A practical bedroom that clips into the PARTY-S tent to create a versatile shelter you can sleep in. The bedroom covers half of the PARTY floor area.
desc.party_s_connector: A practical connector that joins two TRIMM PARTY-S tents, creating an exceptionally spacious shelter for your garden party or other events.
desc.party_s_floor: Floor for the Trimm PARTY-S tent.
desc.party_s_mosquito_net: A practical mosquito net for the PARTY-S tent. Clipped into the Trimm Party it creates a versatile shelter protected from annoying insects.
desc.party_s_wall_regular: A side wall for the PARTY-S tent that easily closes the tent and provides protection from bad weather.
desc.party_s_wall_window: A side wall with a zip and windows for the PARTY S shelter. The zip allows passage, the windows let in light.
desc.party_s_wall_zipper: A side wall with a zip for the PARTY S shelter. The zip allows easy passage and the wall provides shade and shelter from the wind.
desc.footprint_pack: An external footprint for the Trimm PACK tent that gives better protection from damp and cold, in the vestibule too. Its main purpose is to protect the tent floor from punctures and tears. Thanks to its mechanical resistance it significantly extends the life of the floor, especially in demanding conditions and on uneven ground.
desc.footprint_himlite: An external footprint for the Trimm HIMLITE tent that gives better protection from damp and cold, in the vestibule too. Its main purpose is to protect the tent floor from punctures and tears. Thanks to its mechanical resistance it significantly extends the life of the floor, especially in demanding conditions and on uneven ground.
desc.footprint_pioneer: An external footprint for the Trimm PIONEER tent that gives better protection from damp and cold, in the vestibule too. Its main purpose is to protect the tent floor from punctures and tears. Thanks to its mechanical resistance it significantly extends the life of the floor, especially in demanding conditions and on uneven ground.
desc.tents_poles_gum: TENTS POLES GUM – 10 m from the Trimm repair set range, for repairing or replacing the shock cord in tent poles. The set contains the elastic cord and a wire for threading it.
desc.y_peg_d23: An anodised aluminium tent peg weighing 18 g, 23 cm long. The triangular profile gives better holding and, thanks to its strength, works in harder ground too. The top of the peg has a notch and a cord loop for easier pulling out of the ground and for fixing the guy line.
desc.y_peg_d18: An anodised aluminium tent peg weighing 16 g, 18 cm long. The triangular profile gives better holding and, thanks to its strength, works in harder ground too. The top of the peg has a notch and a cord loop for easier pulling out of the ground and for fixing the guy line.
desc.v_peg_d17: An ultralight V-shaped anodised aluminium tent peg weighing 12 g, 17 cm long. It offers a very good ratio of holding power and durability. Its shape makes it suitable for universal use. The top of the peg has a notch for easier pulling out of the ground and for fixing the guy line.
desc.rock_peg_d16: A light square-profile anodised aluminium tent peg weighing 11 g, 16 cm long. Its shape makes it suitable for very hard, rocky ground.
desc.solid_peg_d18: A light aluminium peg, 7 mm in diameter, weighing 13 g, 18 cm long. Its shape makes it suitable for universal use.
desc.solid_peg_s19: A classic steel peg, 5 mm in diameter, weighing 35 g, 19 cm long. Its shape and material make it suitable for universal use.
desc.solid_peg_s26: A classic steel peg, 7 mm in diameter, weighing 90 g, 26 cm long. Its length and shape make it suitable for heavier loads and for universal use wherever weight is not an issue.
desc.nails_peg_s27: A classic steel peg, 7 mm in diameter, weighing 95 g, 27 cm long. Its length and construction make it suitable for heavier loads and harder ground, and for universal use wherever weight is not an issue.
desc.v_peg_s30: A V-shaped steel peg weighing 75 g, 30 cm long. Its length and construction make it suitable for heavier loads and soft ground. Suitable for universal use.
desc.poles_d50_8_5_mm: A universal set of three 50 cm tent pole sections for replacing a damaged section, cut to length, in any tent with 8.5 mm poles. The poles are made of lightweight Duralumin 7001 T6, which keeps them light and strong.
desc.poles_drw40_6_5_mm: A universal set of three 40 cm pole sections for replacing a damaged section, cut to length, in any tent with 6.5 mm poles. They are made of Durawrap, which keeps them light. Durawrap significantly extends their life and increases their strength and flexibility.
desc.poles_drw50_8_5_mm: A universal set of three 50 cm pole sections for replacing a damaged section, cut to length, in any tent with 8.5 mm poles. They are made of Durawrap, which keeps them light. Durawrap significantly extends their life and increases their strength and flexibility.
desc.poles_drw50_9_5_mm: A universal set of three 50 cm pole sections for replacing a damaged section, cut to length, in any tent with 9.5 mm poles. They are made of Durawrap, which keeps them light. Durawrap significantly extends their life and increases their strength and flexibility.
desc.poles_drw60_11_mm: A universal set of three 60 cm pole sections for replacing a damaged section, cut to length, in any tent with 11 mm poles. They are made of Durawrap, which keeps them light. Durawrap significantly extends their life and increases their strength and flexibility.
desc.poles_s45_15_mm: A universal set of 2×4 pole sections, 45 cm long, which serve not only as spare upright poles for your Trimm tent but can also be used to build your own shelter, for example with a Trimm tarp from the TRACE range. Joining 2×4 sections gives you 2 upright poles 182 cm long.
desc.nord_750: The highest-performance down sleeping bag in the Trimm collection, the NORD 750 is made for high-altitude expeditions where minimal weight and packed volume, maximum thermal comfort and protection from snow and wind are essential.
desc.nord_500: The light NORD 500 down sleeping bag has an ideal ratio of weight to thermal comfort. It is made for extreme travellers as well as active adventurers who prefer minimal packed volume and weight.
desc.nord_350: The light NORD 350 down sleeping bag has an ideal ratio of weight to thermal comfort. It is made for extreme travellers as well as active adventurers who prefer minimal packed volume and weight.
desc.peak_400: The light PEAK 400 down sleeping bag has an ideal ratio of weight to thermal comfort. It is made for extreme travellers as well as active adventurers who prefer minimal packed volume and weight.
desc.peak_250: The lightest sleeping bag in the Trimm collection, the PEAK 250 is for anyone looking for an ultralight down sleeping bag with minimal volume and universal use. It can also serve as an extra inner thermal liner to boost the warmth of another sleeping bag.
desc.arktis: An anatomically shaped mummy sleeping bag with high-quality branded Hollow Fibre filling. It is designed for demanding use in winter camping and climbing expeditions. The refined cut provides comfortable sleep even in emergency conditions.
desc.rack_1200: The Trimm RACK 1200 is the highest-performance bag in the new RACK range of innovative TRIMM sleeping bags. Its main advantage is the modern construction; the refined cut with a 1/4-length additional zip gives high comfort in use. Thanks to the high-quality filling, it delivers excellent insulation for its volume and weight.
desc.gant: A very versatile, comfortable sleeping bag with an attractive look, designed for all-season use. Thanks to the top-grade Tactel fabric and two-layer filling, it delivers excellent insulation at low volume and weight.
desc.balance_wide: Thanks to its dimensions this is an extremely comfortable sleeping bag that stands out with low weight while keeping excellent thermal insulation. With its high-quality filling of 7-hole Thermolite Quallo fibre, this sleeping bag is suitable for all-season use.
desc.balance: A very comfortable sleeping bag that stands out with low weight while keeping excellent thermal insulation. With its high-quality filling of 7-hole Thermolite Quallo fibre, this sleeping bag is suitable for all-season use.
desc.battle_2in1: An all-season sleeping bag with a front zip and high-quality Thermolite Quallo filling. Its strength is the excellent ratio of thermal insulation to low weight. The 2in1 function lets you use the sleeping bag as a long insulated vest.
desc.traper: The Traper sleeping bag is at home in high-mountain hiking and on trekking trips. A mummy cut and a filling of high-quality microfibre. Suitable for the beginning and end of the summer season.
desc.walker: A comfortable sleeping bag for summer hiking, paddling and cycle touring.
desc.walker_flex: The growing version of the Walker Junior sleeping bag. A unique construction lets you extend the bag by 30 cm – the sleeping bag grows with your child. The folded-away excess serves as extra insulation around the feet.
desc.highlander: A versatile sleeping bag for use all year round. The anatomical shape, low weight and small packed size will please every user.
desc.rack_800: Another sleeping bag from the new range of innovative TRIMM sleeping bags is the RACK 800. Here too the main advantage is the modern construction; the refined cut with a 1/4-length additional zip gives high comfort in use. Thanks to the high-quality filling, it delivers excellent insulation for its volume and weight.
desc.impact: A very light sleeping bag that takes up minimal space when packed and compressed, made for summer travel, cycle touring, paddling trips and summer trekking. Filling of high-quality microfibre.
desc.rack_400: The lightest sleeping bag from the new range of innovative TRIMM sleeping bags is the RACK 400. Here too the main advantage is the modern construction; the refined cut with a 1/4-length additional zip gives high comfort in use. Thanks to the high-quality filling, it delivers excellent insulation at low volume and weight.
desc.travel: A very light blanket-style sleeping bag. Thanks to its low weight, small packed size and quality filling, it is suitable for the widest range of ordinary trips outdoors.
desc.tramp: A highly comfortable XXL blanket-style sleeping bag for everyone who likes comfort. The blanket construction lets you use it not only for camping and family trips but also as a regular blanket at the cottage or simply in the car.
desc.divan: An exceptionally comfortable sleeping bag for everyone who loves comfort and freedom. The extra width and special construction go beyond what you expect from a sleeping bag, allowing unrestricted movement while sleeping or resting.
desc.haven: The HAVEN bivy bag packs easily into a small roll or into its rectangular case. The bag can also be used as a sun tarp or a poncho. It has Kevlar eyelets and can be turned into an emergency transport sled.
desc.liner_mummy_p: A universal hygienic liner for mummy sleeping bags that also increases thermal comfort. Made of highly breathable 100% PES with a brushed surface that is soft and smooth to the touch. It can also be used as a stand-alone blanket. Other advantages are its small volume, low weight and carry bag.
desc.liner_blanket_p: A universal hygienic liner for blanket-style sleeping bags that also increases thermal comfort. Made of highly breathable 100% PES with a brushed surface that is soft and smooth to the touch. It can also be used as a stand-alone blanket. Other advantages are its small volume, low weight and carry bag.
desc.thermal_liner_mummy_f: A universal thermal liner for mummy sleeping bags that increases warmth. Made of highly breathable 100% PES fleece that is soft and smooth to the touch. It can also be used as a stand-alone blanket. Other advantages are its small volume, low weight and carry bag.
desc.thermal_liner_blanket_f: A universal thermal liner for blanket-style sleeping bags that increases warmth. Made of highly breathable 100% PES fleece that is soft and smooth to the touch. It can also be used as a stand-alone blanket. Other advantages are its small volume, low weight and carry bag.
desc.compress_bag_s: The Trimm COMPRESS BAG S compression sack reduces the packed size of a sleeping bag. The volume can be reduced by up to 40% by tightening the 4 compression straps.
desc.compress_bag_m: The Trimm COMPRESS BAG M compression sack reduces the packed size of a sleeping bag. The volume can be reduced by up to 40% by tightening the 4 compression straps.
desc.wake_5_5: The Trimm WAKE 5.5 inflatable mat stands out above all with its small packed size. It is light and insulates perfectly from cold and uneven ground. Its colours and pattern will appeal especially to women travellers.
desc.tiguan_5_0: A lightweight version of the Trimm TIGUAN 5.0 inflatable mat. It stands out with low volume and low weight thanks to the ultralight fabric used.
desc.zero_5_5: The ZERO inflatable mat stands out with a unique combination of materials: 100% polyester pongee spandex + 150D Oxford with TPU. The mat feels very pleasant and, thanks to its stretch, adapts better to the body. It is light and packs well into its small carry bag.
desc.stepper_5_5: The Trimm STEPPER 5.5 inflatable mat, 56 cm wide along its whole 190 cm length, provides full comfort. On top of that it has an integrated pillow and an integrated inflation pump. The 40D ripstop nylon fabric guarantees high durability.
desc.stepper_duo_5_5: The Trimm STEPPER DUO 5.5 inflatable mat, 120 cm wide along its whole 190 cm length, provides full comfort for two. On top of that it has an integrated pillow and an integrated inflation pump. The 40D ripstop nylon fabric guarantees high durability. Thermal resistance 1.3.
desc.charge_8_5: The Trimm CHARGE 8.5 inflatable mat stands out with a high R-value of 3.6 and a small packed size. Thanks to its thickness it insulates perfectly from cold and uneven ground.
desc.hiker_2_5: The Trimm Hiker 2.5 mat is a perfect companion on the trail. It is a very durable self-inflating mat that provides ample comfort and thermal insulation.
desc.space_3_7: The anatomical shape of the Trimm SPACE 3.7 mat makes it ideal for active use, wherever weight and volume need to be kept down. The horizontal-core construction saves weight while keeping high thermal comfort.
desc.corner_6_0: The rectangular Trimm CORNER 6.0 mat takes care of your maximum comfort. Up to 6 cm thick, it smooths out uneven ground perfectly and delivers a high R-value of 4.1. The horizontal-core construction saves weight while keeping high thermal comfort.
desc.freedom_xl_5_0: A highly comfortable and pleasant self-inflating mat, the Trimm FREEDOM XL 5.0 has excellent insulating properties and a high R-value of 3.6.
desc.altea_l_5_0: The Trimm ALTEA L 5.0 self-inflating mummy-shaped mat with a non-slip surface and a metal valve. Its special construction significantly improves comfort and insulation. It comes with a practical carry bag and a repair kit, and offers excellent insulation with a high R-value of 5.6.
desc.lancer_7_0: The LANCER 7.0 self-inflating mat provides maximum comfort thanks to its thickness and size. Its maximum R-value of 7.0 makes it suitable for cold climates too. Fitted with a non-slip surface.
desc.yetty_10_0: The comfortable Trimm YETTI 10.0 mattress, double-bed sized with 10 cm of profiled foam, gives you maximum comfort and perfect insulation with a thermal resistance of 10.7. The surface is brushed polyester, which stops your sleeping bag sliding and is very pleasant to the touch. Ideal for family trips, cottages or emergency sleeping for unexpected guests.
desc.bubbles_1_8: The Bubbles mat is indestructible and versatile. Thanks to its closed cells it is extremely dimensionally stable, does not absorb moisture and is very durable. It reliably protects from cold, wet and hard or sharp ground. The raised honeycomb structure also makes lying on it comfortable. The foam is thicker in the middle than at the ends for maximum insulation of the torso. Folded up, the Bubbles mat can also be used as a seat pad.
desc.rotto_12_0: The Trimm ROTTO XL 12.0 inflatable anatomical pillow is recommended for calm, relaxed sleep on the road, in a tent, outdoors or just for resting in the garden. It stands out with its pleasant surface of 100% polyester pongee spandex. The pillow measures 46 × 32 cm. Deflated, it packs into a small 12 × 8 cm bundle weighing 95 g.
desc.lexus_12_0: The Trimm LEXUS 12.0 anatomical pillow is recommended for calm, relaxed sleep on the road, in a tent, outdoors or just for resting in the garden. It stands out with its pleasant surface of 100% polyester pongee spandex.
desc.buddy_5_0: The Trimm BUDDY 5.0 self-inflating seat pad provides excellent insulation and comfortable seating at all kinds of outdoor activities, sports matches, concerts and so on.
desc.opal_40: Another backpack from the new Trimm generation. Ideal not only for short hikes and day trips but also for more demanding treks. The fabric gives the backpack an ideal volume-to-weight ratio. The backpack has a comfortable back system.
desc.alpin_40: A durable, practical backpack with well-thought-out details. An anatomically adjustable back system goes without saying. Suitable for weekend hiking, cycling and all winter ski activities.
desc.courier_35: A comfortable, light backpack for weekend trips to the mountains with a highly breathable back system. Thought out down to the smallest detail with plenty of clever features, it also stands out with modern colour combinations.
desc.otawa_30: A hiking backpack of modern construction. Thanks to the ventilated back system it is suitable for longer hikes as well as day trips.
desc.manta_30: A durable, practical backpack with well-thought-out details. An anatomically adjustable back system goes without saying. Suitable for weekend hiking, cycling and skiing.
desc.havana_28: The HAVANA 28 is the smaller model in the range of backpacks with modern shapes. The anatomically shaped back system and chest and hip straps make it comfortable to carry. With its features, low weight and volume it suits all sports activities.
desc.escape_25: A modern and highly functional hiking backpack. Its fresh colours will appeal especially to girls and young women. Thanks to the perfectly ventilated back system it is also suitable for longer hikes.
desc.cruiser_12: A light backpack equipped among other things with a special pocket for a hydration bladder, an ideal solution for hiking and cycling. Zipped main compartment, organiser pocket, outer mesh pocket. Padded shoulder straps. Anatomically shaped straps, adjustable chest strap.
desc.biker_6: A special lightweight backpack with a hydration bladder, ideal for extremely demanding endurance sports. Zipped main compartment, outer mesh pocket, elastic cord on the front panel. Padded shoulder straps. Anatomically shaped straps. Adjustable chest strap.
desc.start_4: A light cycling backpack also suitable for endurance sports and cross-country skiing. The construction allows for a hydration bladder. Fitted with adjustable breathable straps. A padded, ventilated back goes without saying.
desc.new_york_100: A travel bag made of durable materials, fitted with wheels. Opens in the middle (divider). Telescopic handle for rolling on the integrated wheels. Reinforced base and edge protection.
desc.bootbag_20: A ski boot bag made of durable material. Year-round use for inline skates and ski boots including a helmet and protectors. Main compartment with rear access, front pocket for accessories, adjustable and removable shoulder strap, padded handle.
desc.backup_10: A light packable shoulder bag. It folds easily into a small bundle, ideal for shopping or travel, and stores anywhere thanks to its low weight and volume.
desc.money_belt: The practical, discreet Money Belt wallet is suitable above all for travel and sport. Thanks to its skin colour and slim design it is practically invisible under clothing. Divided into separate pockets inside. The elastic belt with a buckle makes it easy to handle.
desc.money: A practical wallet for travel and everyday use. A compartment for documents, space for up to four payment cards inside, a coin compartment and space for banknotes.
desc.bags_rain_cover_s: A Trimm backpack rain cover in size S, for backpacks of 20–35 l. Made of durable waterproof fabric in a bright colour with a reflective print, so it also improves your safety in poor visibility. It reliably protects the backpack and its contents from bad weather. It attaches to the backpack with an elastic loop.
desc.bags_rain_cover_l: A Trimm backpack rain cover in size L, for backpacks of 35–50 l. Made of durable waterproof fabric in a bright colour with a reflective print, so it also improves your safety in poor visibility. It reliably protects the backpack and its contents from bad weather. It attaches to the backpack with an elastic loop.
desc.transit_140: A spacious, fully waterproof travel bag. Welded seams and a waterproof roll-top closure with buckles guarantee maximum watertightness. Compression straps.
desc.saver_25l_long: A waterproof dry bag ideal for water sports. Welded seams and a waterproof roll-top closure with a buckle guarantee maximum watertightness.
desc.saver_x_28l: A waterproof transparent dry bag ideal for water sports. Welded seams and a waterproof roll-top closure with a buckle guarantee maximum watertightness.
desc.omega_2l: A high-quality hydration bladder with an antibacterial finish. Thanks to the MEGA cap the inside of the bladder is freely accessible and easy to clean.
desc.desert_2l: The high-quality Trimm DESERT hydration bladder with a 2-litre capacity has an antibacterial finish. Thanks to the large cap the inside is freely accessible and easy to clean after use. It will serve you well on hikes and during sport whenever you need a quick, easy drink.
desc.armada_1_5l: The high-quality Trimm ARMADA hydration bladder with a 1.5-litre capacity has an antibacterial finish. Thanks to the large cap the inside is freely accessible and easy to clean after use. It will serve you well on hikes and during sport whenever you need a quick, easy drink.
